news.analysis: Tucker has not kicked in the NFL since the 2024 season, following a much-publicized violation of the league's personal-conduct policy. He's now alongside fellow veteran kicker Harrison Butker in Kansas City. Butker has struggled a bit this season, and Tucker could win out between the two. The situation should become clearer as the practice week moves forward.
news.contents: Justin Tucker signed with the Chiefs' practice squad on Wednesday.
news.title: Justin Tucker signs with Chiefs

news.contents: The Kansas City Chiefs have signed veteran kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad, according to The Kansas City Star's Sam McDowell. They also worked out Ben Sauls and Harrison Mevis during the week but opted for Tucker. Tucker has played 13 seasons with the Baltimore Ravens, making 89% of his kicks and earning five All-Pro and seven Pro Bowl honors. With Chiefs kicker Harrison Butker struggling, going 11 for 16 on the season, the team added Tucker to the practice squad. Tucker served a ...
news.title: Chiefs Sign Justin Tucker to their Practice Squad

news.analysis: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.
news.contents: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.title: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver CeeDee Lamb had a couple of impressive catches to help the Cowboys dismantle the banged-up Philadelphia Eagles by a score of 38-21 on Monday Night Football. Lamb was by far quarterback Dak Prescott's favorite weapon in the win, as he caught five of a team-high 12 targets for a team-high 74 yards and two touchdowns. George Pickens saw half the number of targets, although he found the end zone as well. The 27-year-old five-time Pro Bowler now has six touchdown ...
news.title: CeeDee Lamb Shines on Monday Night With Two-Touchdown Performance

news.analysis: The veteran played pretty well on Monday. He hauled in five passes over the course of the game and was able to turn that into 48 yards, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish in most league formats. He will likely continue to be startable moving forward, especially if DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses more time.

news.contents: Baltimore Ravens running back Justice Hill has emerged as an intriguing handcuff option with some existing low-end standalone value in PPR leagues. None of his fantasy outputs have been truly explosive, but he has been relatively steady week over week. news.contents: Detroit Lions star wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) is still dealing with an ankle injury and did not practice on Wednesday, according to The Detroit News' Nolan Bianchi. St. Brown apparently tweaked his ankle in Sunday's Week 7 win over the division-rival Green Bay Packers, but the 27-year-old still played 78% of the offensive snaps and had a big game for his fantasy managers, catching nine of his 11 targets for 153 yards.
